import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_6.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
stats = g.agg(['mean','std'])
df['z'] = df.apply(lambda r: (r['BilledCost'] - stats.loc[(r['SubAccountName'], r['ServiceName']),'mean']) / stats.loc[(r['SubAccountName'], r['ServiceName']),'std'], axis=1)
top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).iloc[0]
print(top['ChargePeriodStart'], top['SubAccountName'], top['ServiceName'], top['BilledCost'])
# sanity: show series around that date
sub = df[(df.SubAccountName==top['SubAccountName']) & (df.ServiceName==top['ServiceName'])].sort_values('ChargePeriodStart')
print(sub.tail(8))
